notes: Real held-out test metrics from reports/metrics/test_metrics.json (the group-aware eval split). The macro figures above (precisionMacro/recallMacro/f1Macro) are computed over the three labels with support in this split; the classification report's own 'macro avg' (~0.40) averages across all FIVE label slots and is dragged down by the two zero-support classes.

`mixed` and `unclear` have ZERO support in this test split, so their per-label F1 is 0 by definition (no examples to score). They are not broken classes — the demo corpus simply contains no held-out examples for them.
These are evaluation numbers on a small annotated slice, not production accuracy; the backend defaults to mock/LLM stance and only calls this model when STANCE_ANALYSIS_PROVIDER=custom_ml|hybrid.
